description: Track your investments and net worth across accounts in one place.

promotion.reason: Approved by the owner. Qualified as offered on 2026-09-12: a real install of Ghostfolio 3.69.0, upstream's current release proved it starts, opens to a first screen with a clear next step, survives a restart and a keep-data reinstall with its data and generated credentials intact, and removes everything it created. Local Store wrote this definition from the project's own deployment instructions.

risk_notes: Creates 3 Docker containers and publishes one port on this computer's loopback interface only.
Generates 4 credentials of its own, keeps them beside the app's data, and reuses them if you reinstall.
Keeps its data in this app's managed folder. A keep-data uninstall leaves it; deleting data removes it permanently.
Proven on Windows with Docker's Linux engine. macOS and Linux hosts are unverified.
Written by Local Store from the project's own deployment instructions, not taken from an app store.
Creates your account from a security token rather than a password: save the token it shows, because it is the only way back in.
Fetches prices and market data from the providers you configure, from this computer.
Holdings and transactions live in PostgreSQL beside it.

config.content:
{
  "id": "ghostfolio",
  "name": "Ghostfolio",
  "version": "3.69.0",
  "source": "https://github.com/ghostfolio/ghostfolio",
  "website": "https://ghostfol.io",
  "documentation": "https://github.com/ghostfolio/ghostfolio#run-with-docker-compose",
  "short_desc": "Track your investments and net worth across accounts in one place.",
  "categories": [
    "Money, Budgeting & Management"
  ],
  "license": "AGPL-3.0",
  "form_fields": [
    {
      "type": "random",
      "label": "Token salt",
      "min": 48,
      "max": 48,
      "env_variable": "GHOSTFOLIO_ACCESS_TOKEN_SALT"
    },
    {
      "type": "random",
      "label": "Sign-in secret",
      "min": 48,
      "max": 48,
      "env_variable": "GHOSTFOLIO_JWT_SECRET_KEY"
    },
    {
      "type": "random",
      "label": "Database password",
      "min": 32,
      "max": 32,
      "env_variable": "GHOSTFOLIO_DB_PASSWORD"
    },
    {
      "type": "random",
      "label": "Cache password",
      "min": 32,
      "max": 32,
      "env_variable": "GHOSTFOLIO_REDIS_PASSWORD"
    }
  ]
}
